The '''NA LCS 2013 Spring''' split was the inaugural split of the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]] season, organized by Riot Games and held from February 7 to April 28, 2013. Eight teams competed in the league’s first official season, including five organizations invited from the [[World_Championship/2012/Regional_Finals/North America|2012 North American Regional Finals]] and three teams promoted through the [[LCS/North America/2013/Spring/Qualifier|2013 Spring Qualifier]].

The season featured a quadruple round-robin Group Stage with Best-of-One matches, followed by a Single-Elimination Playoffs bracket where all series were Best-of-Three, except for the Grand Final which was Best-of-Five. The top six teams advanced to the Playoffs, with the top two from the Group Stage receiving byes to the Semifinals. The top four teams from the split automatically qualified for the [[LCS/North America/2013/Summer|2013 Summer Split]], while the bottom four were sent to the [[LCS/North America/2013/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion]] to defend their league spots.
